ACME ROBOTICS, INC.
Consolidated Financial Statements FY2025 (Audited)
Independent Auditor: Chen & Willis LLP
INCOME STATEMENT (US$)
Revenue                          3,204,118
  Subscription revenue           1,872,404
  Usage fees                       913,220
  Hardware sales & install         418,494
Cost of revenue                  1,884,022
Gross profit                     1,320,096
Gross margin                     41.2%
Operating expenses               4,102,377
  R&D                            1,988,105
  Sales & marketing              1,306,880
  G&A                              807,392
Operating loss                  (2,782,281)

BALANCE SHEET HIGHLIGHTS (US$, Dec 31 2025)
Cash and equivalents             4,918,551
Accounts receivable              1,152,730
  Days sales outstanding (DSO)   87 days
Inventory (robot components)       688,214
Deferred revenue                   941,808
Long-term debt                   1,500,000
Total shares outstanding         10,000,000

NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
Note 3. Revenue recognition: subscription recognized ratably;
usage fees on delivery of monthly pick reports.
Note 5. Customer concentration: largest customer represents 31%
of FY2025 revenue.
Note 7. Substantially all robotics equipment has been pledged as
collateral for the US$1.5M credit facility with First Pacific Bank.
Note 9. Subsequent events: in March 2026 a customer representing
approximately 9% of FY2025 revenue notified termination of its
service agreement effective June 2026.
